name: Almond Pudding
instructions: In a heavy 3 quart saucepan , combine the milk or light cream , rice , and cardamom
Cook , uncovered over low heat , stirring occasionally about 1 hour or until the milk mixture is reduced to about 2 cups
Stir in the sugar and chopped almonds or pistachio nuts , continue stirring till the sugar has dissolved
Stir in the rose water , if desired
Spoon the mixture into 4 to 6 sherbet or dessert dishes
To serve , sprinkle with ground nutmeg and garnish each serving with 2 whole strawberries
